results.name: A skill card offers Deliver, Edit, Archive and Delete
Edit opens the card on the stored SKILL.md
Save changes starts disabled (nothing changed) and says everything is saved
Typing marks the draft unsaved and enables Save changes
The header is read live: name, size and the checksum note
A broken header says why and keeps Save changes off
The button shows Saved with a drawn check on the button itself
The workspace holds the edited text
The checksum and size were recalculated to match
Identity and provenance are kept (id, date added, target)
The draft is clean again after saving
The button went pending -> success -> idle, kept focus semantics (aria-busy, not disabled)
Success stays about 2.4 s before the button returns to idle (measured 2.40 s)
The width springs back on the measured spring (critical, about 27 rad/s)
Ctrl+S saves
Changing the name in the header renames the skill everywhere
A clashing name is refused with the reason, and the button is idle again
Nothing was stored for the refused edit
Done closes the editor
Delete morphs into an inline question with Cancel and a hold-to-confirm button
Confirm takes focus (so Enter answers) and the control is a labelled group
Escape cancels the question and focus returns to the button
A press outside cancels the question
A quick click does not delete in hold mode
Letting go early deletes nothing, and the fill drains back to empty
The hold fill is a straight line that takes one second (measured 0.1 %/ms)
Holding the full second deletes the skill from the workspace at once
The card stays in place showing Deleted and Undo
Undo is focused so a keyboard user can take it back
Undo puts the skill back in its old place, in the workspace
The restored card is a normal card again with its delete button at rest
Enter on the button opens the question with Confirm focused
Letting go of Enter early does not delete
Holding Enter for a second deletes
After the result has been shown for a while the card leaves, and the skill stays deleted
A deletion survives a reload
The pill grows on the slower measured spring (critical, about 12.6 rad/s)
...and shrinks on the faster one (critical, about 16 rad/s)
The pill is 32 px tall in a card row
If the workspace cannot store the change the button does not say Saved
Dark theme: the fill is the light danger colour with dark text
Phone: the editor fits without horizontal overflow
Phone: the question fits without horizontal overflow
Phone: holding the confirm button with a finger for a second deletes
Reduced motion: the pill lands in one step
Reduced motion: the hold fill still shows progress
No console errors
